problem.title: Conventional cores weren't built for this
problem.subtitle: Symphonie, Delta, Temenos T24. These platforms were engineered for interest-based banking and retrofitted with Islamic product modules as an afterthought.

income.title: Income recognition mislabeled
income.desc: Legacy platforms label Murabaha profit as "interest income" in reports and general ledgers. Your Shariah board sees it. Your auditors flag it.

cobac.title: Regulatory reporting is manual chaos
cobac.desc: Central bank and regulatory returns compiled by hand from dozens of separate exports and spreadsheets. Every quarter feels like an audit crisis.

governance.title: Shariah governance lives outside the system
governance.desc: Advisory board approvals tracked in email threads and paper files instead of the core system. No audit trail. No version control.

eod.title: End-of-day takes hours
eod.desc: EOD takes 2 to 3 hours and still leaves items unreconciled across multiple spreadsheets. Operations staff work late every single day.

tikariDifference.title: TIKARI is different
tikariDifference.desc1: The ledger is built on AAOIFI financial accounting standards from the ground up. Every product type (Wadiah, Mudarabah, Musharakah, Ijara) has its own GL logic, profit-sharing mechanics, and Shariah validation flow.
tikariDifference.desc2: Your Shariah Advisory Board and your compliance team are first-class users in the system, not an afterthought. Central bank reporting is automatic. EOD closes in under 10 minutes.

whyTikari.title: Shariah-first. Not Shariah-retrofitted.

fourEyes.title: Four-eyes on everything

fourEyes.title: Four-eyes principle
fourEyes.desc: Every financial operation goes through maker-checker approval. No single user can initiate and approve the same transaction, reducing operational and compliance risks under regulatory supervision.

audit.title: Immutable audit trail

riskSharing.description: Financial institutions share in your business success via profit-sharing, not just extracting fixed interest.

flexibleStructures.title: Flexible Structures
flexibleStructures.description: Financing products designed around business cycles, not rigid payment schedules that ignore cash flow reality.

earlySettlement.title: Early Settlement Benefits
earlySettlement.description: Pay off Murabaha financing early and receive discounts on the markup. Incentives for financial discipline.

businessPartnership.title: Business Partnership
businessPartnership.description: Islamic banks act as true partners in your growth, not just creditors demanding fixed payments.

applicationProcess.title: Simple Application Process
applicationProcess.description: TIKARI streamlines the entire financing application process. From initial inquiry to disbursement, everything is tracked in the platform with complete Shariah compliance documentation.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Provide business details, financial statements, and financing requirements through the TIKARI platform.

steps.title: Shariah Review
steps.description: Your application is screened for Shariah compliance and matched with appropriate Islamic finance products.

steps.title: Credit Assessment
steps.description: The financial institution evaluates your business creditworthiness and determines the financing terms.

steps.title: Contract & Disbursement
steps.description: Sign Shariah-compliant contracts with transparent markup disclosure. Funds disbursed to your business account.

cta.title: Ready to Finance Your Business Growth?
cta.subtitle: Connect with Islamic financial institutions offering Murabaha, Musharakah, Ijara, and Salam financing for Africa's SME sector. All transactions in local currencies with transparent Shariah-compliant structures.

jurisdictions.title: Supported Jurisdictions
jurisdictions.subtitle: TIKARI operates across multiple regulatory frameworks, bringing AAOIFI non-interest banking compliance to financial institutions across Africa.
jurisdictions.intro: Designed for Africa's diverse regulatory landscape, TIKARI is configured to adapt to local central bank guidelines and microfinance directives.

cemac.title: Central Africa Region
cemac.desc: Full compliance with regional banking regulations for microfinance institutions and monetary directives. Pre-configured for local currencies and automated prudential returns.

nigeria.title: Nigeria (CBN)
nigeria.desc: Aligned with the Central Bank of Nigeria's (CBN) regulatory guidelines for non-interest financial institutions, supporting non-interest window models and full ledger segregation.

waemu.title: West Africa Region
waemu.desc: Compliant with regional central bank prudential requirements for non-interest microfinance and banking institutions, pre-configured for local currency operations.

eastafrica.title: East Africa & Others
eastafrica.desc: Adaptable configuration supporting localized central bank regulations in East Africa, featuring multi-currency accounting (KES, UGX, TZS, RWF) and local tax frameworks.

aaoifi.title: AAOIFI Accounting
aaoifi.desc: Fully compliant with the Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions (AAOIFI) Financial Accounting Standards (FAS).

ohada.title: OHADA Compliance
ohada.desc: Seamless mapping to the OHADA accounting framework, ensuring dual compliance with regional commercial standards.

shariah.title: Shariah Governance
shariah.desc: Searchable Fatwa repository and automated maker-checker workflows that keep Shariah Advisory Boards and external auditors aligned.

cta.title: Deploy TIKARI in Your Country
cta.desc: Ready to launch regulator-compliant non-interest banking products? Schedule a technical demo with our implementation team.

brand.description: Africa's leading faith-based non-interest banking platform. Complete AAOIFI-compliant financial infrastructure engineered for Islamic banking, microfinance, and traditional savings systems.

assurance.title: 100% Shariah Compliant & Regulator Approved
assurance.description: All financial products are certified by our independent Shariah Supervisory Board and operate in full compliance with regulatory guidelines across our supported jurisdictions.
